EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Card Suspended
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Your student ID card has been reported as lost or stolen. We have disabled your card to prevent any unauthorized purchases or building access.
If you find your card, please email us at sundevilcardinfo@asu.edu and we will re-enable your ID card.
If your card was stolen you may obtain a new card at no cost by bringing a valid police report to any one of the four Sun Card Office locations. https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices#fees-and-location
If your card was lost, please visit the Replacement Card section of our website for replacement options. https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices#replacement-cards
Regards,
{!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
